descricao:
Cast Maddening Cacophony with kicker by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each opponent to mill half their library, rounded up.
Activate Riverchurn Monument's exhaust ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and tapping it, causing each opponent to mill the remainder of their library.

Cast Overture by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each opponent to mill half their library, rounded down.
Activate Riverchurn Monument's exhaust ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and tapping it, causing each opponent to mill the remainder of their library.

Cast Traumatize by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing a player to mill half their library, rounded down.
Activate Riverchurn Monument's exhaust ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and tapping it, causing each player to mill cards equal to the number of cards in their graveyard, thus causing the player targeted by Traumatize to mill the rest of their library.

Cast Singularity Rupture with kicker by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each opponent to mill half their library, rounded up.
Activate Riverchurn Monument's exhaust ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and tapping it, causing each opponent to mill the remainder of their library.
